feature: Empirical retrieval spike — test git-based retrieval strategies for recall@100 on n=20 eval cases
problem: V4 architecture separates retrieval (scripts) from reasoning (LLM). Before building the production retrieval module (P16), we need empirical data on which git-based strategies achieve best recall@100 — i.e., whether the ground truth buggy commit appears in the top 100 candidates. V3 agent finds the correct commit in only 10/20 cases (Hit@5=0.50); a high-recall retrieval stage could provide the agent with a much better starting set.
proposed_solution: Build a spike evaluation harness that tests 6 retrieval strategies (file log, keyword grep, pickaxe, blame, recency fallback, time-window) against the frozen n=20 eval set. Measure recall@K for each strategy individually and combined. Use Level 1 regex extraction for hints. Produce a findings ADR with strategy recommendation, set size, and Retrieval Recall@100 gate/target values for P16.
acceptance_criteria: AC2: src/commit_investigator/eval/retrieval_spike/ with recall_at_k() (12-char prefix match) and RetrievalStrategy protocol
AC3: Harness loads results/v3-subagent-eval-v2/manifest.json and runs all 20 cases without manual case list
AC4: Every strategy enforces temporal bound; spot-check asserts zero candidate commits are descendants of fix_hash
AC5: Level 1 extraction populates extracted_files, extracted_symbols, extracted_keywords on ProblemStatement; results/retrieval-spike/hint_coverage.json reports per-case signal counts
AC6: Individual strategy JSON artifacts for file_log, keyword_grep, pickaxe, blame, recency_fallback, time_window — each with per-case recall@100 and aggregate mean
AC7: Combined strategy (union of top individual strategies) JSON with recall@50, recall@100, recall@200
AC8: Set-size analysis table in findings ADR comparing 50 vs 100 vs 200 for recommended combined strategy
AC9: Conditional Level 2 — if best Level 1 combined recall@100 >= 0.70, findings doc documents skip with rationale; else Level 1 vs Level 2 comparison table on same combined strategy
AC10: .harness/docs/retrieval-spike-findings.md Status Accepted — answers Q1–Q4, recommends strategy + set size + ranking heuristic for P16, proposes gate/target recall@100 values
AC11: docs/evaluation-framework.md Retrieval Recall@100 gate/target TBDs replaced, referencing retrieval-spike-findings ADR
AC12: No embedding/vector-store imports or calls (rg verification); git subprocess only
AC13: pytest coverage for recall_at_k metric and at least one strategy; full suite still passes
AC14: results/retrieval-spike/summary.json committed or generated by script with reproducible command documented in findings ADR
edge_cases: E1: Cases with zero extracted hints (no file paths, no symbols in JIRA text) — combined strategy must have fallback (recency) producing non-empty candidate set
E2: Temporal bound parent resolution fails (fix_hash is first commit or repo shallow) — strategy must handle gracefully, log warning, skip case
E3: Pickaxe/keyword search returns 1000+ commits — strategies must cap and rank, not pass unbounded lists
verification_method: Evaluator runs scripts/run_retrieval_spike.py --manifest ... --strategy combined --k 100 --output-dir results/retrieval-spike/ and verifies JSON output matches AC format. Checks recall_at_k against per-case bug_hash. Reads findings ADR for Q1-Q4 answers. rg for embedding/vector-store imports. pytest tests/ passes.
